Results file locations are described in each subsection. 5.1 Speed Distribution by Speed Bin For the first analysis, the speed distributions were calculated based on MOVES criteria. The speed bins are separated as follows: speed bin 1 contains speeds equal to or greater than 0 mph and less than 2.5 mph, bin 2 captures speeds greater than or equal to 2.5 mph and less than 7.5 mph, and so forth.
